criteria.requirement: The meter-based 3D park includes two entrances, fixed paths, trees, accessible restroom and a useful initial stage/stalls/seating/info plan.
criteria.action: Inspect the sample park, its dimensions and initial equipment.
criteria.expected: The meter-based site includes two entrances, paths, trees, restroom, stage, stalls, seating and information desk.

criteria.requirement: Add/select/move/rotate/duplicate/delete edits, dimensions, numeric fields and snapping stay synchronized with the equipment list.
criteria.action: Add, select, move, rotate, duplicate and delete equipment using dragging and numeric fields; toggle snapping.
criteria.expected: Scene and equipment list share selection and edits; footprints and dimensions match the objects.

criteria.requirement: Outside placements are prevented and footprint overlaps visibly identified; top/orbit/zoom/reset-camera remain usable.
criteria.action: Attempt an outside placement and an overlapping placement; use top, orbit, zoom-to-selection and reset views.
criteria.expected: Outside placement is prevented, overlaps are highlighted, and the required camera views remain usable.

criteria.requirement: Undo/redo cover object edits without undoing camera navigation.
criteria.action: Make object edits and camera changes, then undo and redo.
criteria.expected: Object edits reverse and restore without undoing camera navigation.

criteria.requirement: Documented obstacle-aware pedestrian and step-free routes connect either entrance to facilities, show meters, recompute after edits and exclude the stepped shortcut in step-free mode.
criteria.action: Route from each entrance to a facility in pedestrian and step-free modes, then edit obstacles.
criteria.expected: Routes avoid equipment, show meters and update after edits; step-free routes exclude the stepped shortcut and routing assumptions are documented.

criteria.requirement: A reproducible blocked-route edit reports no route, and warnings select the relevant objects without reliance on color alone.
criteria.action: Apply the sample route-blocking edit and select a resulting warning.
criteria.expected: No-route conditions are reported and warnings select relevant objects without relying only on color.

criteria.requirement: Activities validate end-after-start, detect overlapping bookings at one facility while allowing touching boundaries, and warn about capacity.
criteria.action: Create valid, reversed-time, overlapping, touching-boundary and over-capacity activities.
criteria.expected: Invalid end times are rejected, same-facility overlaps and excessive attendance warn, and touching boundaries remain allowed.

criteria.requirement: Deleting a booked facility explicitly offers cancellation or removal of its bookings, preventing dangling references.
criteria.action: Delete a booked facility once by cancelling and once by removing its bookings.
criteria.expected: Cancellation preserves the facility and bookings; confirmed deletion removes its bookings without dangling references.

criteria.requirement: Local save and validated JSON import/export reproduce identifiers, positions, bookings and routing; invalid imports preserve current work.
criteria.action: Save and reload; export/import a plan, then attempt an invalid import.
criteria.expected: IDs, positions, bookings and routes restore; invalid input preserves the current plan.

criteria.requirement: Confirmed reset and printable layout/equipment/schedule/warnings summary work; keyboard and mobile editing forms remain usable.
criteria.action: Exercise confirmed sample reset, print summary, keyboard actions and mobile forms.
criteria.expected: Reset requires confirmation, the summary contains layout/equipment/schedule/warnings, and keyboard/mobile editing stays usable.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the sample park, equipment, initial schedule and documented routing assumptions.
Edit equipment with numeric and drag controls, test undo/redo and routes in both access modes, then change a booking.
Block a route, submit invalid placement/time/import, test touching and overlapping bookings, cancel a booked-facility deletion and roundtrip a saved plan.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
